item.name: Get Special Service Requests (SSR) for a Category

request.name: Get Special Service Requests (SSR) for a Category

description.content:
Returns the list of Special Service Requests (SSR) for a selected category.
Every `category` type can contain multiple service requests.
For example, the `category: MEAL` includes service requests such as a vegetarian meal, baby/infant meal, 
gluten free meal, and so on. These service requests are displayed as `subCategory` fields within the `category: MEAL`. 
To learn more about a selected category such as its `subCategory` values, category code, and other relevant
information, run this API using the `category` type as the query parameter.

query.description: (Required) The category type of a Special Service Request (SSR).
